## SCYNEXIS to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences


September 01, 2026 8:30am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_1c9b04b1055f4eede03d715469c95b65/scynexis/news/2026-09-01_SCYNEXIS_to_Participate_in_Upcoming_Investor_368.pdf)


JERSEY CITY, N.J., Sept. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SCYNEXIS, Inc. (Nasdaq: SCYX), a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing innovative therapies for severe and difficult-to-treat diseases with significant unmet medical need, today announced that the company will participate in the following investor conferences:


- 12th Cantor Global Healthcare Conference in New York City
Fireside chat: Friday, September 11, 2026, at 9:45 a.m. ET.


- H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference in New York City
1x1 investor meetings: September 14-16, 2026


A live webcast of the Cantor fireside chat will be available[here](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=rNDty2BgNocelyxGdq7V9OQGEUlL8pfozgzI13777VwGTx0ZJqb0pcZIOKb8dkxhptwshroVD7zZvH712xf9kiRR03GFPDf9MREUASOYR8SWGFp6s4xpVe6Dr27i5Fw-0daUffGaBtT0dTTe2WHWwe-DJk_pab9fh5_HyocMoEmJ4pcQaZJx3d7r6GCdmJ1nx18B5fkJkw659e8nE_Y0gWQ-PnMSDDLhbN2OLf6MUDE=) . A replay will be available for 90 days following the event.


**About SCYNEXIS**


SCYNEXIS, Inc. (NASDAQ: SCYX) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing innovative therapies for severe and difficult-to-treat diseases with significant unmet medical need. SCY-770 is being developed for the treatment of Autosomal Dominant Polycystic Kidney Disease (ADPKD) and has been granted Orphan Drug designation. SCYNEXIS’s proprietary antifungal platform “fungerps” includes BREXAFEMME® (ibrexafungerp tablets), the first approved representative of this novel class, which has been licensed to GSK, and SCY-247, currently in clinical stages of development. For more information, visit www.scynexis.com
